intent.primary_message: You do not need to arrive organized to begin learning
supporting_information: Keep notebooks, materials, questions, and real progress connected
intent.desired_action: Bring one real study fragment into Artilearn and start the next useful learning task
intent.audience: Students managing multiple subjects, materials, and assessment workflows; exact segment unvalidated

concept.visual_proposition: One authentic imperfect study fragment becomes one clear next action without being magically cleaned away
concept.visual_proof: A single indigo Learning Thread carries context from the fragment into a calm workspace and ends at one coral next-action node
concept.brand_specific_angle: Artilearn connects the student's real materials, notebook context, questions, learning actions, and honest progress

hierarchy.primary: headline and one continuous fragment-to-action journey

composition.hero: one continuous Learning Thread connecting an imperfect question to one available next action
composition.secondary_mass: tactile study fragments and restrained workspace geometry
composition.negative_space: left 38 percent reserved as low-frequency copy field
composition.eye_path: headline to imperfect fragment to Learning Thread to coral next action to CTA
composition.crop_logic: preserve the thread origin, workspace, and endpoint; peripheral fragments may crop decisively
composition.background: warm canvas with restrained paper grain
composition.typography_zone: clean left field separated from the right visual mass

typography.alignment: left aligned to primary copy anchor
typography.line_break_logic: break by meaning: Bring your / mess. / Start learning.

color.value_structure: ink headline and indigo thread remain distinct from the warm canvas in grayscale
color.accent_strategy: indigo carries continuity; one coral endpoint indicates the next action; marigold is annotation only
color.contrast_target: WCAG AA minimum; target 7:1 for body where practical

effects.name: soft contact shadow
effects.purpose: ground the paper and interface layers while preserving a calm low-elevation composition

brand_rules: No final logo was supplied; wordmark is provisional
Do not imply grades, AI intelligence, magical organization, or unsupported product behavior
Progress must be derived from recorded activity
One fragment and one next action per asset
observed_patterns: Assistant workspace is the primary product anchor
Context should persist across notebooks, materials, tools, and progress
inferred_choices: Learning Thread as campaign-specific visual behavior
Bring Your Mess as prototype campaign platform
restraints: No generic AI brain, robot, neon orb, trophy, graduation cap, confetti, or feature-icon cloud
No more than one decorative thread
No UI rearrangement that depicts a non-existent flow
